{"fragment": true, "screens": [{"tag": "screen", "attrs": {"name": "screenpart_TimeshiftOverviewBody", "size": "1920,1080"}, "children": [{"tag": "widget", "attrs": {"backgroundColorSelected": "md_surface_container_high", "enableWrapAround": "1", "foregroundColorSelected": "md_primary", "itemCornerRadiusSelected": "6", "position": "0,0", "render": "Listbox", "size": "1920,1080", "source": "list", "transparent": "1", "backgroundColor": "md_surface", "foregroundColor": "md_on_surface", "scrollbarMode": "showOnDemand", "scrollbarSliderBorderColor": "md_on_surface", "scrollbarSliderBorderWidth": "1", "scrollbarSliderForegroundColor": "md_on_surface_variant", "scrollbarWidth": "5", "selectionFrame": "none"}, "children": [{"tag": "convert", "attrs": {"type": "COCTemplatedMultiContentEx"}, "children": null, "text": "{
	"var": (
		ih := 70,
		hspace := 10,
		thumb_w := ih*2-10,
		thumb_h := ih-10,

	],
